questions.stem: How is an isolated congenital bulla or cyst managed in bullectomy, and how fit are these patients?
questions.answer: Managed the same way; these patients are often much fitter

questions.stem: Which investigations make up the cardiac assessment before bullectomy?
questions.answer: Angiography, right heart catheterisation, echo, pulmonary artery pressure
